body_lead: Maharashtra Govt Sets Up 3-Tier Panels to Oversee AI Policy, Approve Incentives The committee will also coordinate AI projects involving multiple departments, facilitate partnerships with AI companies and research institutions, and review implementation progress quarterly Mumbai: The Maharashtra government has set up three committees to oversee the implementation of its Artificial Intelligence (AI) Policy 2026, with a state-level executive panel tasked with approving incentives and subsidies for AI projects.
